violated_contract: A seed authority that named bundles mirror on every launch must hold the operator's effective preferences. A present-but-stale authority domain — installed, but missing overrides the operator curates in the app they actually use — makes exact mirroring delete real overrides and ship compiled defaults, and an existence-only fallback never repairs it because the failing state is 'present but stale', not 'absent'.
canonical_prevention: Resolve exactly one authority per run — explicit env source that fails closed on a missing domain, then the production app when installed, then the dev profile — keep exact-mirror deletion semantics against that single authority, warn when it lacks a shortcut override naming the compiled default, and test resolution order, fail-closed behavior, and mirror deletion against a prepopulated target.
